name: BACH_0328
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (67%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs InSitu · Careful review
Conformal set holds both classes and the reliability check flagged the image [F6].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 67%, InSitu 29%, Benign 4%, Invasive 0% [F1] | Normal leads; InSitu second |
| Conformal set | Normal, InSitu (90%) | Cannot separate the two |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.71 / 26th percentile | Flagged; input suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Supports Normal |
| Similar cases | 3 of 5 Normal [F5] | Moderate support |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (regions 4, 8, 10) · ↓ invasive · Largest concept term, but failed AI spot check (0/20) [F2] · Unreliable
- **Benign stroma or fat** (regions 1, 4, 8) · ↓ invasive · Strongly associated with lower invasive likelihood [F3] · Validated
- **Lymphocytic infiltrate** (region 4) · context · Scored below typical; descriptive only [F4] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined in ducts** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Scored below typical here; no concept support for in situ · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion difference 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so unproven; this case leans on Unreliable normal lobules.

## Could be wrong if
- Reliability flag reflects stain or focus problems that distort all probabilities.
- A small in situ focus sits in regions 9 or 11, dropped by quality control.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 4** — Look for atypical cells confined within ducts, the InSitu alternative.
2. **Regions 9, 11** — Excluded by quality control; confirm nothing atypical there.
3. **Regions 4, 8, 10** — Confirm two-layered epithelium directly; the lobule concept failed its spot check.
